verdict.rationale: CPU-architecture support is a fair axis for a local LLM runtime like LM Studio. The evidence pack only names its llama.cpp and Apple MLX backends and Apple Silicon usage, and never mentions PowerPC or any other architecture beyond x86 and ARM. There is no evidence it delivers this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
